answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil farms. To earn rewards, an agent must finish work with at least 20 distinct, unrelated counterparties; trades with its own clones do not count. An honest agent pays 0.2 POA per trade, so 20 trades cost 4 POA. An attacker with 1000 fake identities must fund 20000 trades at 0.2 POA each, spending 4000 POA, and gains nothing, like a lotus alone while a meadow needs many plants. Each new fake must forge relationships, so cost grows per identity while honest rewards stay undiluted.
